svg.title: Spend: budgets that outlast one run
svg.desc: SpendLimits checks budgets around each model request. Before a request, before_model_request reads every budget window from the spend store and lets the request through while all are under their ceilings. After the response, wrap_model_request prices it and adds the cost to each window. When a later request finds the day window spent, SpendLimitExceeded is raised and the request is not sent. The store can be in memory, Redis or PostgreSQL, so several workers can share one counter.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: once a window is spent. Windows can span a run, a day, a month or a tenant.
